entities.summary: Delesio Antonio Berni was an Argentine figurative artist. He is associated with the movement known as Nuevo Realismo, an Argentine extension of social realism. His work, including a series of Juanito Laguna collages depicting poverty and the effects of industrialization in Buenos Aires, has been exhibited around the world. Antonio Berni was a painters & sculptors from Rosario (1905-05-14, Rosario–1981-10-13). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
